title: A normalized adic transition is a flat tensor short exact sequence
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative ring, J an ideal and N an object of the standard derived category of constant A-module sheaves on the coefficient-sized pro-etale site [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For n a natural number let U_n and t_n be exactly its normalized underlying reductions and transitions. Then there exist a K-flat cochain complex P over the residue coefficient sheaf [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-kflat-complex], an isomorphism Q(P) to the residue reduction, a residue module sheaf M, and a short exact sequence S of A-module cochain complexes, together with isomorphisms e2:Q(S.X2) to U_(n+1) and e3:Q(S.X3) to U_n such that Q(S.g) composed with e3 equals e2 composed with t_n. In every integer degree q there is an isomorphism from H^q(S.X1) to scalar restriction of the ordinary tensor-test homology of P with M[0] [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, lem-pe-coefficient-tor-flat-model]. No boundedness, Tor bound, product or completeness is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the existing flat K-flat representative theorem to the residue reduction adicFiniteReduction X J N 0. This supplies P, its IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients proof, and the comparison Q(P) ≅ adicFiniteReduction X J N 0.

Invoke the coefficient-kernel transition construction for this fixed P. It supplies the residue module, short exact complex, normalized comparisons with the two reductions, the transition square, and the degreewise residue tensor-test homology isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem adicFiniteTransition_tensor_sequence
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (N : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ P : Cx (constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) (adicFiniteCoeff J 0)),
      P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients ∧
      Nonempty ((Q _).obj P ≅ adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N 0) ∧
      ∃ (M : Mod (constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
          (adicFiniteCoeff J 0)))
        (S : ShortComplex (Cx (constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A))),
        S.ShortExact ∧
        ∃ (e₂ : (Q _).obj S.X₂ ≅ adicFiniteUnderlying.{u, v} X J N (n + 1))
          (e₃ : (Q _).obj S.X₃ ≅ adicFiniteUnderlying.{u, v} X J N n),
          (Q _).map S.g ≫ e₃.hom = e₂.hom ≫ adicFiniteTransition.{u, v} X J N n ∧
          ∀ q : ℤ, Nonempty (S.X₁.homology q ≅
            (res (quotient (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J 0)).obj
              (coefficientModelTensorTest _ P M q))
